question: When is touching the divine lord strictly prohibited in ritual observance?
premises: The thirteenth day of the month Pauṣa is specified.
The divine lord is the object of the action.
Touching is negated in any place.
inference: On the thirteenth day of Pauṣa one must not touch the divine lord anywhere.
plain_english: On the thirteenth day of Pauṣa, one should not touch the divine lord anywhere.
